integrity: All invariant factors follow from a complete proof. Exact finite checks reproduced from packaged code; they do not certify the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Squarefree moduli only; not arbitrary principal minors. Independent mathematical and publication-priority verification not performed.
scientific_scope: Unit-excluded Ramanujan divisor matrix for every squarefree positive integer with at least two prime divisors; exact integer Smith normal form, cokernel, and modular kernel size.
title: Smith invariants of squarefree unit-excluded Ramanujan divisor matrices
